Claim 1 (currently amended): A gas generator comprising: a composition containing an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent, and a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total composition; and a desiccant in operable communication with said composition, wherein the composition further comprises a processing aid selected from the group consisting of graphite, fumed silica, and mixtures thereof.

Claim 2 (currently amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said desiccant is mixed into said composition at about 10-35 weight percent of the total composition.

Claim 3 (currently amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said desiccant is in vapor communication with, but physically separated from, said composition, and said desiccant is provided in amounts resulting in a mass differential of about -5.0 to 5.0% of the composition after heat aging at 107C for 400 hours.

Claim 4 (currently amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said composition contains an extrusion aid provided at about 0.1-10 weight percent of the total gas generant composition.

Claim 6 (currently amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said alkali metal chlorate is selected from the group consisting of potassium chlorate and sodium chlorate.

Claim 7 (currently amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from tartaric acid and its isomers, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, and mucic acid, and mixtures thereof.

Claim 8 (currently amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said carboxylic acid is DL-tartaric acid.

Claim 13 (currently amended): A composition comprising: an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent; a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent; and a desiccant provided at about 5-35 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total gas generant composition; and a processing aid selected from the group consisting of graphite, fumed silica, and mixtures thereof. 

Claim 14 (currently amended): The composition of claim 13 wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from tartaric acid and its isomers, DL-tartaric acid, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, and mucic acid, and mixtures thereof.

Claim 15 (currently amended): The composition of claim 13 wherein said alkali metal chlorate is selected from the group consisting of potassium chlorate and sodium chlorate. 

Claim 16 (currently amended): The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is selected from activated calcium sulfate, silica, zeolite, clay, and calcium oxide, and at least one is a processing aid. 

Claim 18 (currently amended): The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is selected to provide a mass differential of about -5.0% to 5.0% after heat aging at 107C for 400 hours.
